description: This Java source file defines a mock implementation of an MQTT client factory for testing purposes, specifically mocking interactions with HiveMQ MQTT client library. It includes methods for simulating connection failures, message exchanges, subscription handling, and disconnects, utilized in unit testing scenarios within the project.

classes.name: MockHiveMqtt5ClientFactory
classes.description: A mock implementation of HiveMqtt5ClientFactory for testing HiveMQ MQTT client interactions, supporting simulation of connection errors, message exchanges, subscriptions, and disconnections.

methods.name: withException
methods.description: Configures the mock factory to simulate a connection exception when attempting to connect.

parameters.name: connectException
parameters.description: The exception to throw during connection attempt.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the mock client's message store, associated with its topic.

methods.name: withMessages
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the mock client's message store.

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: The list of MQTT messages to add.

methods.name: withTestProbe
methods.description: Sets the ActorRef testProbe used for verifying published messages during tests.

methods.name: withFailingSubscribe
methods.description: Configures the subscribe future to complete exceptionally, simulating a subscription failure.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect() was called at least once on all clients within a timeout period.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a mocked MQTT async client that simulates connection, disconnection, subscription, and publishing behaviors.

parameters.name: reconnect
parameters.description: Flag indicating if client should reconnect.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mocked builder for MQTT client, with nested configuration mocks.
